info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Assigns-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of support tickets that are currently assigned within the system. This API serves as a vital resource for support teams and administrators seeking to manage ticket workloads effectively. By accessing the ticket data, users can track the status and details of assignments, ensuring timely and effective customer service. Common use cases include monitoring ticket distribution among support agents and analyzing performance metrics. This enhances coordination and improves the overall support experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve tickets that have been assigned to a specific user or team. It provides information on the current status and details of each assigned ticket.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to assign tickets to users. Please ensure that the provided data conforms to the required schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of assigned tickets.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for assigning tickets in the operations GET request.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.
